concept_name: Two monsoons

item.question: Mumbai's rain peaks in July and Chennai's in November. Which monsoon brings each peak?
steps: The south west monsoon reaches the west coast from June to September, which covers July.
The north east monsoon reaches the south east coast in October to December, which covers November.
So Mumbai's peak comes from the south west monsoon and Chennai's from the north east monsoon.
item.answer: Mumbai: south west monsoon; Chennai: north east monsoon

item.question: On a 3 by 3 Hex board the players fill all 9 cells. Can the game end with neither player joining their two sides?
steps: Try filling a small board in every way you can: one colour always joins its two sides.
A wall of one colour that blocks the other side is itself a chain across the board.
So a full board always has exactly one winner.
